# eon_resource_environment_override (Resource)

Manually overrides the environment for an inventory resource, replacing auto-classification.

When this resource is created or updated, the listed environment is applied as a manual override. When destroyed, the override is removed and auto-classification resumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Override auto-classified environment for an inventory resource
resource "eon_resource_environment_override" "demo" {
  resource_id = "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d"
  environment = "PROD"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment to set as the manual override. Possible values: `PROD`, `PROD_INTERNAL`, `STAGE`.
- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource whose environment is overridden.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource. Mirrors `resource_id`.
